author: Lintuxer
tagline: Login admin / change-me-asap — keyboard-driven file manager in a browser tab
description: superfile is a terminal file manager built for the keyboard: multiple panels side by side, fuzzy search, batch rename, compress and extract, a metadata pane and previews for text, images, video and PDFs. This package ships the upstream release binary together with ttyd, so the whole thing runs in a browser tab against the shares you mount into it — no client to install, no separate terminal. Press "?" inside for the hotkeys. The browser asks for a login on first open: user "admin", password "change-me-asap" — change it in the app settings, because anyone who gets in can also run shell commands from superfile's command line. Treat it as a password to the machine, not to an app.

tips.before_install: LOGIN: user "admin", password "change-me-asap" — this is what the browser will ask for the first time you open the tile. CHANGE THE PASSWORD: it is printed in a public file, and it does not guard a document, it guards a terminal that can read, move and delete every folder mounted below. Edit SPF_PASSWORD right here before you press install. An empty password is refused and the app will not start. Two more things: the mounts under /files are exactly what the app will be able to reach, nothing else, and the published port must stay off 7681 because ZimaOS runs its own web terminal there.

title: Superfile
